Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Batangas, Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Cuyapo, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Palayan, Pantabangan, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug), Rizal(Tanay, Baras, Jala-Jala, Pililla), Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan) and Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel, Norzagaray).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bataan and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Metro Manila, Cavite, Tarlac(San Manuel, Moncada, Anao, Paniqui, Ramos, Gerona, Pura, Victoria, Tarlac City, La Paz, Concepcion), Bulacan(San Ildefonso, San Rafael, Baliuag, Pulilan, Calumpit, Angat, Balagtas, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Santa Maria), Nueva Ecija(San Antonio, Zaragoza, Jaen, Santa Rosa, San Leonardo, Gapan, San Isidro, Cabiao, Penaranda), Rizal(San Mateo, Rodriguez, Antipolo, Taytay, Cainta, Angono, Binangonan, Teresa, Morong, Cardona) and Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Los Banos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
